title: Father's Last Words
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao saw the killing intent in Chen Ji's eyes and quietly tightened the Jade Pendant in her hand—she knew that this man was about to make a decision that could overturn the entire Tianqing Sect.

text.content:
In the instant Chen Nian collapsed, Chen Ji felt a tearing pain somewhere in his chest, as if an invisible thread had been violently snapped. Deep within the Forbidden Grounds, that ancient call was like a primordial beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years opening its eyes, watching this pair of blood-related siblings.

His legs gave way and his knees crashed heavily onto the cold stone floor, yet his hands tightly clutched his sister's body, refusing to let go. Chen Nian's face was pale as paper, a wisp of blood trickling from the corner of her mouth, her breathing so faint it was barely perceptible.

"Niannian... Niannian!" Chen Ji's hoarse voice echoed through the empty Forbidden Grounds, but only echoes answered. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered violently on the first page, letting out a heavy sigh: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key... truly cannot be awakened lightly."

dialogue.content:
"She is temporarily unharmed, but to fully awaken her, a more complete Tianji Record is needed." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried exhaustion, "Boy, your current state..."

Before he could finish, Chen Ji felt darkness swallow his vision, his consciousness plummeting like a stone sinking into an abyss, falling rapidly. The Chen Nian in his arms also seemed to be held aloft by some force, suspended in mid-air.

From the depths of the Forbidden Grounds came rumbling sounds, as if something was awakening. Those stone pillars covered in runes began to emit a ghostly blue glow, illuminating Chen Ji's gradually dilating pupils.

text.content:
—Deep within consciousness, chaos like ink.

Chen Ji suddenly found himself standing in a familiar scene. It was the Bamboo Grove behind the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the morning mist still undispersed, the air filled with the fresh scent of dew. The bamboo leaves rustled, like countless people whispering.

"This is... Father's memory?" He looked down at his own hands, discovering they had a translucent, illusory quality. The Tianji Record in his arms radiated gentle warmth, the characters on the fragment flowing like water.

Mo Xiansheng's voice came from the void, carrying rare solemnity: "In the process of the Tianji Record repairing the Heavenly Fate Value, it automatically retrieves memory fragments related to your destiny. Your father's obsession at his death's end... is being replayed at this moment."

Deep within the Bamboo Grove, a staggering figure struggled forward.

It was a middle-aged man, his features gaunt yet resolute, bearing a striking seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji. His garments were soaked through with blood, a black dagger piercing his chest, each step leaving alarming bloodstains on the ground.

"Father!" Chen Ji instinctively wanted to rush forward, yet found his body immobile, able only to watch like a bystander.

He saw his father leaning against the bamboo, coughing violently, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. The old man's turbid eyes were filled with unwillingness and fury, his trembling lips seeming to mutter something.

dialogue.content:
"Five... Five Elder..." The old man's voice was hoarse and faint, yet every word was clear, "You deceived me... you said merely to seal the Tianji Record... why... why kill my son..."

Chen Ji's heart suddenly tightened, as if gripped by an invisible hand. The "Five Elder" his father mentioned—the head of the "Five Elders Council," the highest authority in the Tianqing Sect, the true ruler of the entire sect!

He saw his father using his final strength to drip a drop of essence blood into the Jade Pendant in his arms. That Jade Pendant suddenly burst forth with blinding light, transforming into a stream of light flying toward some direction.

"Ji'er... Father is incompetent... but you must... must survive... the true secret of the Tianji Record... is... is..."

text.content:
Before the words could finish, a凌厉 sword light slashed from the depths of the Bamboo Grove.

That sword light was silent yet carried a suffocating pressure, as if capable of severing everything in this world. The old man's body suddenly stiffened, a completely black magical sword piercing through from his back, fresh warm blood still dripping from its tip.

"Chen Shidi, did you think I didn't know what you were doing?" An aged yet authoritative voice came from the shadows, "The one chosen by the Tianji Record... cannot be allowed to live."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji felt as if all the blood in his body was boiling, burning, about to explode! His fingernails dug deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he felt no pain whatsoever.

He saw that blurred figure emerge from the shadows—an elderly in gray robes, his features dignified, hair and beard entirely white, a faint Spiritual Light swirling around him. Though his features were deliberately concealed, the coldness and arrogance in those eyes were branded into Chen Ji's heart.

"Five Elder..." He spoke each word with deliberate emphasis, his voice hoarse and barely human, "I remember."

The old man slowly turned around, as if sensing something. He narrowed his eyes to look in Chen Ji's direction, a playful smile curving his lips: "Oh? There's actually a spy? No matter, anyway after today, everyone who knows the truth will be dead..."

text.content:
—Tianqing Sect, a certain quiet chamber.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, gasping for air like a drowning person finally breaking the water's surface. Cold sweat had soaked through his inner garments, clinging stickily to his back, bringing waves of bone-deep chill.

"You're finally awake." Su Qingyao's voice came from beside him, carrying undisguised anxiety.

Chen Ji turned his head to see Su Qingyao sitting by the bed, her plain white garments stained with a few spots of blood—from tending to him. Her complexion was pallid, dark circles beneath her eyes, clearly having kept watch for a long time.

"How's Niannian?" Chen Ji's first words, his voice hoarse and terrible.

"Already taken care of, temporarily out of danger." Su Qingyao handed over a cup of warm water, "You kept calling out for Father while unconscious... what exactly happened?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took the water cup but didn't drink, only gripping it tightly. His knuckles were white from force, as if wanting to crush this cup.

He didn't answer Su Qingyao's question, instead closing his eyes to sense the changes within his body. The Heavenly Fate Value was slowly recovering, each point carrying his father's sorrow and indignation at death. And within those recovering Heavenly Fate Values, a wisp of faint thermal current was intermingled.

"This is..." Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes.

He discovered that deep within his Mental Sea, there was an additional fragment the size of a fingernail. The fragment was dark gold, its surface covered with densely packed patterns, faintly resonating with the Tianji Record's runes.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice timely sounded, carrying a trace of relief: "That is the map fragment Chen Xuan left at his death. It seems he long anticipated this day, hiding the clue to the other half of the Tianji Record within your Bloodline."

Chen Ji's spiritual sense moved, and that fragment floated into his palm. He gazed intently, discovering those patterns were not ordinary runes but a miniature map—pointing to a certain location deep within the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds.

"Father's legacy..." Chen Ji murmured, his voice low and frightening, "So he had long left clues, only never finding the right opportunity to tell me."

Su Qingyao gazed at the fragment in Chen Ji's palm, her brow slightly furrowing: "This map... the location it points to seems to be the core area of the sect's Forbidden Grounds."

choice.prompt: After learning the truth of his father's murder, Chen Ji faces his first choice:

choices.description: Before the Five Elder notices, take the initiative to investigate the secrets deep within the Forbidden Grounds

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, his eyes burning with long-suppressed fury. He gazed at that dark gold fragment in his palm, his voice low as an abyss: "Five Elder... my father treated you as an elder brother, yet you killed him with your own hands. Today I, Chen Ji, swear to heaven—I will take your head and offer it as a sacrifice to my father's spirit in the heavens!"

choices.memory_label: 得知父亲被五长老所杀

choices.description: Continue playing the废物, secretly gather the Five Elder's evidence and wait for the right moment

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. He turned to look at Su Qingyao, his eyes regaining their usual calmness: "Qingyao Shijie, there are some things I wish to discuss with you alone. Regarding... the true reason my father left the sect back then."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's expression shifted slightly at these words. As the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, she naturally knew about the incident when Chen Xuan "defected" years ago. That was a taboo so deeply buried within the Tianqing Sect that anyone who dared mention it would be severely reprimanded.

"You... truly remember?" Her voice trembled slightly. "Regarding your father—that incident from back then, there are indeed many suspicious points. I once looked through some archives and discovered that your father's departure was nothing like what the sect officially announced..."

She lowered her voice, her gaze warily scanning their surroundings. "But this matter runs too deep. If the Five Elders Council were to learn that someone was investigating this, the consequences would be unthinkable."

text.content:
Chen Ji observed Su Qingyao, a complex mix of emotions stirring within him. This woman—from initially viewing him as worthless, to gradually sensing something amiss, and now willing to risk everything to speak candidly with him—each of her transformations was like dancing on the edge of a blade.

"Senior Sister Qingyao." He suddenly spoke, his tone considerably more composed than before. "Why would you help me?"

Su Qingyao paused, then offered a faint smile. "You think I'm helping you?" She rose and moved to the window, positioning herself with her back to Chen Ji. "I'm merely pursuing the truth. The events of those years run far more intricate than you've imagined. And you—perhaps you hold the key to uncovering that truth."

choice.prompt: Confronted with Su Qingyao's candid revelation, Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Tell her about what his father witnessed before death, but conceal the Tianji Record's secret
choices.risk_hint: Once trust is established, if discovered concealing something, may turn hostile

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then finally spoke. "Just now, while unconscious, I witnessed the instant of my father's death. He didn't defect—he was murdered by someone within the sect. Before he died, he shouted out the killer's name."

Su Qingyao spun around abruptly, her pupils contracting sharply. "Who?"

"Elder Five." Chen Ji spoke each word with deliberate precision. "The leader of the Five Elders of Tianqing Sect."

The air seemed to crystallize in that instant. Su Qingyao's face turned deathly pale, her lips quivering slightly, yet no words would come.

text.content:
Chen Ji shook his head, revealing a bitter smile. "Now is still not the time to speak of it. Senior Sister Qingyao, I can only tell you that my father was framed by someone. And that person... is likely among the sect's senior leadership."

Su Qingyao's brow creased tightly, clearly dissatisfied with this response. Yet she pressed no further, simply fixing Chen Ji with a profound gaze. "If you ever need assistance with anything, don't hesitate to ask."

At that moment, a soft knock came at the quiet room's door.

"Chief Su, the Sect Master requests your presence." A disciple's voice came from beyond the door. "He says there are urgent matters regarding the Forbidden Grounds' abnormal activity that require discussion."

Su Qingyao and Chen Ji exchanged a glance. The Sect Master—that was Ling Yuan, the highest authority of Tianqing Sect, nominally subordinate to the leader of the Five Elders. Yet in Chen Ji's eyes, this man was far from what he appeared to be.

"I'll return shortly." Su Qingyao adjusted her clothing, her expression returning to its usual cold detachment. "Rest well for now, and don't engage in unnecessary worry."

She walked to the door, then suddenly paused, her head turned slightly back. "Chen Ji, I don't know what you're concealing. But I hope... when the truth is finally revealed, you will still be the person you are now."

dialogue.content:
The door closed, leaving Chen Ji alone on the bed's edge. His fingers gently brushed across the dark golden fragment resting in his palm.

Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated in his mind, carrying a hint of amusement. "Young man, what do you intend to do? Elder Five is someone you must kill, but with your current strength, you couldn't even defeat one of his guards."

Chen Ji offered no response. He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into his spiritual awareness, beginning to carefully examine the fragment. The map on the fragment wasn't complete—it appeared to be merely one section of a whole. Yet even so, he could discern its indicated location—the core of the Forbidden Grounds, the place where an ancient existence lay sealed.

"My father's keepsake..." he murmured to himself. "There truly is more to this."

choice.prompt: Alone, Chen Ji contemplated his next move.

choices.description: While Su Qingyao is away, immediately head to the Forbidden Grounds' depths to search for other clues left by his father
choices.visible_cost: Might encounter the Forbidden Grounds' guardian
choices.visible_reward: Discover more truth about the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Solo action carries extremely high risk

text.content:
Chen Ji rose abruptly, a resolute gleam flashing in his eyes. He knew he couldn't wait any longer—if Elder Five had been capable of killing his father back then, he would certainly eliminate any potential threats without hesitation. Better to take the initiative than wait for disaster to strike.

He tucked the map fragment into his chest, quietly sliding open the window. Outside, the moonlight hung hazy and faint—perfect cover for his intentions.

choices.description: First conserve your strength, wait for Su Qingyao to return before making plans
choices.visible_reward: Restore Heavenly Fate and organize your thoughts
choices.risk_hint: The Fifth Elder may strike first

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly lay back on the bed, forcing himself to calm down. Anger is poison, it makes people lose their reason. He silently recited in his heart: Those chosen by the Tianji Record never die from impulse.

He began to sort through the information he currently possessed: his father was killed by the Fifth Elder, the other half of the Tianji Record's clues were hidden in the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, and Chen Nian's existence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight... All of this seemed to point in the same direction.

choices.description: Contact Ye Qing through the Holy Sect's secret channels to obtain external support
choices.visible_cost: Expose connection with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful concealment methods and intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered by righteous cultivators

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took out a pitch-black jade talisman from under his pillow—the contact token Ye Qing had left him before departing. He infused a thread of spiritual energy into it. Ominous demonic patterns surfaced on the talisman's surface, then it turned to ash and dissipated.

After completing this, Chen Ji lay down again, a meaningful smile curving his lips: "Demonic Path Saint... I wonder if your Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record?"

choices.memory_label: 联系魔道圣女寻求帮助

text.content:
About the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, the window moved without wind, and a black shadow slipped in silently.

Ye Qing was still dressed in that seductive yet dangerous manner, her face hidden behind black纱, revealing only a pair of soul-stealing eyes. But at this moment, her expression was unusually grave, completely different from her usual frivolous self.

"You're insane?" she lowered her voice, her tone carrying a rare reproach, "The forbidden grounds have changed, the entire Tianqing Sect is on high alert, yet you contact me at this moment?"

Chen Ji slowly sat up. Moonlight filtered through the window lattice, casting on his face, outlining a countenance so calm it was almost cold: "Precisely because of the alert, I need your help."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing slightly narrowed her eyes, as if reassessing the man before her.

"You've changed," she suddenly said, "Before, you always had a harmless appearance. Now... your eyes are like poisoned blades."

Chen Ji smiled gently, yet there was no warmth in that smile: "Some things change a person."

He briefly told Ye Qing about the fragments of the truth regarding his father's death—of course, omitting the specific details about the Tianji Record. After listening, Ye Qing was silent for a long while, her expression becoming complicated and hard to read.

"The Fifth Elder..." she slowly said, "If he made the move, you have virtually no chance of winning. That old man's strength is enough to rank in the top five of the entire cultivation world."

text.content:
Chen Ji nodded, his expression没有丝毫波动: "I know. That's why I need your Demonic Path mist."

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "What are you planning to do?"

"The aura of the Tianji Record is too conspicuous. Once I delve deep into the forbidden grounds, I will inevitably be detected." Chen Ji stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes, "Your Demonic Path mist can conceal my whereabouts. Correct?"

Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly: "You're really pushing your luck. However..." her gaze deepened, "I enjoy cooperating with smart people. But this matter carries too much risk. I need more leverage."

Just then, footsteps came from outside the door.

Ye Qing's reaction was lightning-fast. She grabbed Chen Ji's shoulder, her form turning into a wisp of black mist, vanishing without a trace in the blink of an eye. The two had just concealed their aura when the door was pushed open.

Su Qingyao had returned.

She walked into the room, frowning slightly, as if sensing something unusual. Her gaze swept across the room, finally landing on the slightly swaying window.

"You opened the window?" she asked, her voice calm.

Chen Ji's expression was as usual: "It felt stuffy earlier, so I opened it for some fresh air."

Su Qingyao gave him a deep look but didn't press further. However, the way she gripped the Jade Pendant was noticed by Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao sat down by the bed, her expression complicated as she looked at Chen Ji.

"The Sect Master convened an emergency meeting, announcing anomalies in the forbidden grounds and requiring all core disciples to stand by." She paused, "He also specifically mentioned that there would be a thorough investigation into today's forbidden grounds incident. Everyone who has entered or exited the forbidden grounds must submit to questioning."

Chen Ji's heart tensed, but his face remained unmoved: "This is normal, since something happened in the forbidden grounds."

"But there's something strange." Su Qingyao lowered her voice, a hint of doubt flickering in her eyes, "When the Sect Master mentioned you, he specifically asked—'How is Chen Xuan's son doing now?'"

These words were like a basin of cold water, pouring over Chen Ji's heart. Lin Yuan... actually took the initiative to mention his father?

text.content:
Chen Ji exchanged a glance with the shadowed Ye Qing.

Lin Yuan—that old fox who was outwardly the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect but secretly colluding with the Fifth Elder. His inquiry was by no means coincidental, but carried a certain probing intent.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and looked up to meet Su Qingyao's scrutinizing gaze. At that moment, the killing intent in his eyes was like a materialized blade, making Su Qingyao's heart tremble.

"Qingyao Senior Sister." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "If one day, I do something... out of line, what would you do?"

Su Qingyao looked at the killing intent in Chen Ji's eyes and quietly gripped the Jade Pendant in her hand.
